name: Memoria v0.4.7
body:
## English

### Theme: Tidying Up — turning "we claim it works" into "it actually works on a real machine"

Six tasks were completed, and **four additional genuine defects were found that were not planned**.

#### 1. Context compaction became observable for the first time
The root cause was **not** that compaction was broken. `conversation_messages()` recognised only four
event kinds (user / assistant / loop-end / tool-result), so the `compaction` event **silently fell
through and was discarded**. The summary only ever reached `build_history()` (which feeds the LLM);
the render replay never saw it, so the UI could never show that compaction had happened.

Fix: an opt-in, default-off parameter plus a thin wrapper at the end (the default path is byte-for-byte
unchanged; existing doc anchors do not drift). `compaction` is projected as a `role:"system"` line
inserted at its original position by sequence number. The status row now shows **character budget
usage** — `history_chars(build_history()) / MAX_HISTORY_CHARS` — numerator and denominator in the same
domain (characters), with **no token conversion**, plus a compaction count, turning red past 80%.

Real-machine evidence: a genuine compaction at `compaction seq=61` covering 50 events / 26,154
characters with a 221-character summary; usage went `99% -> 19%`; the system line survived a reload
(read-only replay projection, not in-memory state).

#### 2. "Born-dead" document-resource attachments fixed
Dragging a PDF/Word/TXT/MD into the chat had **never worked since 2026-10-19** — the user always got
a red "images only" box. The backend (`agent_attach_resource`, `read_resource`,
`resources.py::extract_text`) had long been delivered, but the frontend wiring block had been appended
**after the IIFE facade's `return {`**. Assignments and `const` declarations there are statements that
never execute (only `function` declarations hoist, which is exactly what disguised the problem as
"it looks present"). Six helpers also referenced `const`s in that dead zone, leaving a latent TDZ crash.

Fix: moved the whole block before the `return` (pure relocation), and corrected the wrong placement
convention comment, documenting the **convention rot history**: from `2f9a88f9` eleven commits and
nineteen appended blocks followed the correct placement, then `1fe97fa7` (10-19) first wrote the wrong
variant, the block was born dead, and three subsequent commits copied it verbatim.

#### 3. Responsive layout: three-way linkage
Below 720px of document area, the most-recently-expanded pane wins: folder tree auto-collapses or the
chat dock hides; if already collapsed and split, switch to preview. Everything is **derived state — not
persisted, and never overrides the user's own choices** (`CONTENT_MIN_PX=360` deliberately unchanged,
since raising it would make the dock auto-hide first and break rule 1).

**Anti-oscillation**: the decision uses **hypothetical geometry** (the "both expanded" width) with
720/760 hysteresis, because the in-flight animation width crosses the threshold and would otherwise
self-negate. Real machine: 15 small steps back and forth across 700<->780 produced **only 2 switches**.

Also added a three-state tooltip and a weak visual accent explaining that expanding may collapse the dock.

#### 4. Selection matrix: 8 block classes -> 9 (image added)
Images are atomic blocks: 12 additional cases across span1 / span2same / span3mix times
copy / cut / delete / pasteReplace. `run_selection.py` only appended corpus at the end; the logic for
the first 8 classes was untouched, so the historical 146-case basis stays comparable.

**Instrument correction**: the product clipboard had moved to a backend RPC (the root cause of the
WebView2 permission prompt), so the old driver's spy on `navigator.writeText` could not see it — all 35
"cut" cases at HEAD were **false failures**. Switched to backend read-back + a unique sentinel + async
polling + per-case `clipboard.source` labelling. Result: headless 9 classes **158/158**, of which the
original 8 remain **146/146**.

#### 5. Multi-line paste caret verified by pixels
Source area passed: a real Ctrl+V kept all three lines with the caret on the last line's last glyph
(dx=0.0, dy=0px). The preview area revealed a real defect, disclosed below and fixed in 0.4.8.

#### 6. Ledger calibration
Twenty-four windowed-family entries archived as obsolete (`OK-but-forever-checking` contradictions
18 -> 0); `AG59`/`AG63` corrected to "removed by `ed5964c9` (10-09)" — the UI had been gone for 16 days
while the ledger still said "landed"; the remaining ledger items were triaged to **A 0 / B 1 / C 30 / D 0**
with **nothing promoted to done without item-level real-machine evidence**.

#### Known issues (disclosed in the release body)
- **P1**: preview-area multi-line paste with a collapsed caret keeps only the first line.
  Reproduced 10/10 on a real machine via OS-level injection; the source area was 10/10 correct, so this
  is a **product defect**, registered in the matrix `knownIssues` and **fixed in 0.4.8**.
- `AG21` lacks a real-model turn (needs a real LLM endpoint — the user's quota).
- 30 items still lack item-level real-machine acceptance; kept as pending, not marked green.
- The semantics of cutting a lone image (empty clipboard, no warning) is an undefined product decision.
- The shell has no `PermissionRequested` handler, so the permission prompt can return if the RPC fails.

## Cost (Agent compute)

- **Magnitude**: roughly **CNY 300-800** (estimate; not itemised).
- **Accounting basis**: **v0.4.7 ~ v0.5.0 counted as one block.** These three releases cannot be split
  per-version honestly: they share one continuous architecture effort, one acceptance chain, and one
  team session. Token-level accounting was never recorded, so the figure is estimated from session
  rounds and team size rather than metered.
- **Cost structure (one line)**: most of the spend went to **round-after-round real-machine
  verification and root-cause attribution**, not to writing code. In particular, chasing three
  separate "false completion" cases (dead code / born-dead wiring / broken measurement instrument)
  consumed the majority of it.

---

## 中文

>
> **这个安装包里已包含 0.5.0 的架构代码（S1–S5），但当时未在发布说明中提及。**
>
> 原因：0.5.0 曾因越序发布被撤回，撤回时**只回退了版本号、未回退代码**（代码保留在 `src/`），
> 因此本版打包时把 `mcp_server.py`（703 行）/ `section_index.py`（738 行）/
> `trace_index.py`（652 行）等一起打了进去。
>
> **用户可感知的差异**：agent 的**工具面从 65 把增加到 69 把**
> （`outline` / `section` / `snippet` 等粒度读工具已生效），
> 而 0.4.6 及更早版本没有这些工具。
>
> **已由 `v0.5.0` 正式追认**：0.5.0 完成了 R1 级重验收
> （五份旧验收在当前 HEAD 重跑 + 必红夹具重证明 + 12 交互剧本 12/12 + 全量 pytest 1474 passed），
> 并在其发布说明中明确定义这五个阶段。
>
> 本声明是为了让"版本号与实际内容"对齐 —— **不是本版的功能变更**。

---
## Memoria v0.4.7 —— 收摊

本版主题：**把「声称做了」变成「真机上确实做了」**。

六项任务全部完成，并在过程中抓到四个**不在原计划内**的真问题。

---

## 六项任务

| # | 任务 | 结果 |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | §13 台账校准 | 24 条窗口化家族窗口化作废归档；`✅·K2` 矛盾 **18 → 0** |
| 2 | 上下文压缩首次可观测 | 根因**不是压缩坏了**，是渲染投影把 `compaction` 事件丢了 |
| 3 | 三层术语统一 | **能力 capability / 技能 skill / 插件 plugin**；3 份设计文档行号零漂移 |
| 4 | 排版响应式三条联动 | 720px 阈值 + **防振荡**（假想几何 + 迟滞 720/760） |
| 5 | 0.4.6 遗留收尾 | 选区矩阵 **8 → 9 类**（补 image）；多行粘贴光标像素核验 |
| 6 | §13 剩余 K2 收口 | **A 0 / B 1 / C 30 / D 0** —— 没有条目级真机证据就不升 ✅ |

---

## 一、上下文压缩首次可观测

**根因**（比"UI 没显示"更准确）：
```
conversation_messages() 只认 4 类事件
（user / assistant / loop-end / tool-result）
⇒ compaction 事件【静默落空、被丢弃】
⇒ 压缩摘要只进 build_history()（喂 LLM），渲染回放拿不到
⇒ 用户永远看不到压缩发生过
```

**修法**：
- 默认关闭的可选参数 + **末尾薄包装**（默认路径逐字节不变、既有文档锚点零漂移）
- `compaction` 投影成 `role:"system"` 系统行，按 seq **原位置**插入
- 状态区显示**字符预算占用**：`history_chars(build_history()) / MAX_HISTORY_CHARS`
  —— **分子分母同域（都是字符），不做 token 换算**
- 显示**已压缩次数**；>80% 转红提示「该压缩还没压缩」

**真机证据**（不是 headless）：
```
真压缩 compaction seq=61，覆盖 50 条事件 / 26,154 字符，摘要 221 字符
状态：99% → 19%，已压缩 0 → 1 次
重载后系统行仍在（只读回放投影，非内存态）
```

> ⚠️ 首轮真机验证直接抓出：这个 UI 块**是死代码**（落在 IIFE 门面 `return` 之后）——
> headless 单测全绿，真机上**完全没生效**。

---

## 二、文档资源附件「出生即死」6 天

**用户可见症状**：把 PDF / Word / TXT / MD 拖进对话栏 ⇒ 红框「只支持图片」。
后端 `agent_attach_resource` / `read_resource` / `resources.py::extract_text` **早已交付**，
前端接线**从未执行**。

**根因**：前端块被追加在 `IIFE` **门面 `return {` 之后** ⇒
`const`/赋值是**语句**、永不执行（只有 `function` 声明 hoist，恰好把问题掩盖成"看起来在"）。
且 6 条 helper 引用了死区的 `const` ⇒ **TDZ 潜伏崩溃**。

**约定腐化史**：
```
2f9a88f9(09-19) 起 11 个 commit / 19 个追加块 全部遵守正确落点
1fe97fa7(10-19) 首次写成错误变体「})(); 之前」⇒ 本块出生即死
                （且该 commit 标题与资源附件【无关】——顺手追加时按记忆里的旧约定写）
后续 3 个 commit 原样保留
```

**真机 before / after**：
| 环节 | 修复前 | 修复后 |
|---|---|---|
| 拖 `.txt` | ❌ 红框「只支持图片」 | ✅ 无报错 |
| `agent_attach_resource` | ❌ 后端 0 文件 | ✅ 落盘 |
| chip | ❌ 0 | ✅ 出现 |
| 请求体含 `read_resource` 提示 | — | ✅ |
| 发送后清空 / 移除按钮 | — | ✅ |

---

## 三、排版响应式三条联动

- 文档区 `<720px` 时按「**最近展开者优先**」自动折叠文件树或隐藏对话栏
- 已折叠 + 分屏 ⇒ 切预览
- **全部为派生状态、不落盘、不覆盖用户手调**
- `CONTENT_MIN_PX=360` **保持不动**（抬高会让 dock 先被自动隐藏、规则①失效）

**防振荡**（这类自动联动最经典的坑）：
```
判据用「两者都展开」的【假想几何】——且用【期望宽】而非折叠动画中的 DOM 现宽
（0.18s 动画里 DOM 宽 280→0，用它算会跨阈值【自我否定】）
+ 迟滞：进入 720 / 退出 760
真机 700↔780 小步往返 15 步：总切换仅 2 次，无闪烁
```
另补三态 tooltip + 视觉弱强调，说明「点击展开会在空间不足时收起对话栏」。

---

## 四、选区矩阵 8 类 → 9 类（补 image）

图片为**原子块**，覆盖 span1 / span2same / span3mix × copy / cut / delete / pasteReplace 共 **12 例**。
`run_selection.py` **仅末尾追加**语料，前 8 类逻辑一行未动 ⇒ 历史 146 口径可比。

**量具修正**（本轮重要发现）：
```
产品剪贴板已改走后端 RPC（WebView2 权限弹窗根因）
旧驱动 spy navigator.writeText 抓不到 ⇒ HEAD 基线 35 个 cut 全【误报】
改后端回读 + 唯一哨兵 + 异步轮询 + clipboard.source 逐条标注
⇒ headless 9 类 158/158，其中 8 类仍 146/146（与历史同口径）
```

---

## 五、多行粘贴光标像素核验

- **源码区 PASS**：真实 Ctrl+V，3 行全保留，光标落末行末字，**Δx=0.0 / Δy=0px**
- **预览区发现真缺陷** ⇒ 见「已知问题」

---

## 已知问题（如实披露）

| 级别 | 问题 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| **P1** | **预览区折叠光标多行粘贴只保留首行** | 真机 OS 注入 **10/10 复现**，源码区对照 10/10 正常 ⇒ **产品缺陷**；已入矩阵 `knownIssues`（保留不删），**0.4.8 修复** |
| — | AG21 缺真实模型回合 | 需真实端点（花用户额度/发送数据），待明确授权 |
| — | **30 条 K2 仍缺条目级真机验收** | task-94 判为 C 类，保持 `🔄·K2`（**不刷绿**） |
| — | 图片单独 cut 的剪贴板语义未定义 | `edit-handler.js:838` 早退：仅选中图片时不写剪贴板、不提示 |
| — | 壳层无 `PermissionRequested` 处理器 | 后端 RPC 失败时回退 navigator 会再弹权限窗 |

| 文件 | 大小 | 说明 |

解压后直接运行 `Memoria.exe`，无需安装。

## 造价

- **时间**：本版 6 项任务 + 4 项额外发现，串行执行
- **迭代**：过程中发现并修复 3 类系统性「假完成」
  （死代码 / 源码文本断言 / 量具盲区）
- **代价**：0.4.7 从「改进 UI」变成「先证明已有的东西真的能用」——
  这件事本该在 0.4.6 发布前做，而不是发完了才发现资源附件 6 天没工作
- **诚实度**：30 条 K2 保持未升；P1 缺陷如实披露；AG21 不用真实端点

---

**完整变更**：[`docs/conventions/version.md`](docs/conventions/version.md) · **逐项证据**：[`artifacts/agent/verify/todo/`](artifacts/agent/verify/todo/)

## 造价（Agent 算力）

- **量级**：约 **300–800 元人民币**（估算，非逐项计量）。
- **统计口径**：**v0.4.7 ~ v0.5.0 合并统计**。这三版无法诚实切分到单版：它们共享同一条连续的
  架构工作线、同一条验收链、同一个团队会话；且 token 级台账从未记录，故按会话轮次与团队规模估算，
  不是计量值。
- **成本结构（一句话）**：主要花在**逐轮真机验证与根因归因**，不是写代码。其中追查三起独立的
  「假完成」（死代码 / 出生即死接线 / 量具盲区）占了大头。
